reasons.invalid_input: The browser opens only web, file and blank pages.
reasons.tab_not_found: This page is no longer open on the device.
reasons.tab_busy: The tab is busy with another request. Try again in a moment.
reasons.stale_ref: The page changed before the browser could act on it.
reasons.stale_cursor: The browser’s records changed before they could be read.
reasons.stale_inventory: The page’s files changed before they could be read.
reasons.stale_tools: The page’s tools changed before they could be used.
reasons.target_not_found: The browser couldn’t find that on the page.
reasons.ambiguous_target: More than one part of the page matches.
reasons.not_actionable: That part of the page can’t be used right now.
reasons.timeout: The browser didn’t answer in time.
reasons.dialog_blocked: A dialog on the page is waiting for an answer.
reasons.dialog_not_found: The page has no dialog waiting for an answer.
reasons.invalid_dialog_action: The dialog can’t be answered that way.
reasons.history_boundary: The tab has no page to go to in that direction.
reasons.navigation_failed: The browser couldn’t load the page.
reasons.protected_value: The page keeps that value private.
reasons.side_effect_rejected: The browser didn’t let that change the page.
reasons.unsupported_result: The browser can’t pass on what the page gave.
reasons.unsupported_capability: The browser on the device can’t do that.
reasons.output_exists: A file with that name already exists on the device.
reasons.io_error: The device couldn’t read or write a file the browser needs.
reasons.result_too_large: The page gave more than the browser can pass on.
reasons.partial_failure: The browser did only part of that.
reasons.driver_error: The browser on the device ran into a problem.
reasons.browser_unavailable: The browser couldn’t start on the device.
reasons.browser_lost: The browser on the device stopped.
reasons.outcome_unknown: The connection to the browser broke. The result is unknown.
reasons.capture_unavailable: This device can’t capture the browser’s pages.
reasons.capture_failed: The device couldn’t capture the page. It’s trying again.
reasons.capture_stopped: The device couldn’t capture the page.
reasons.conversation_busy: The conversation is busy. Try again in a moment.
reasons.device_not_found: The device was removed from your account.
reasons.cloud_unavailable: The Cloud isn’t available right now.
reasons.cloud_capacity: The server has no room to start the Cloud.
reasons.cloud_crash_loop: The Cloud stopped starting after repeated failures.
reasons.host_operation_failed: The connection to the device broke.
reasons.unknown_plugin_method: This server can’t run a browser.

answers.unreadable: The server’s answer couldn’t be read.

noBrowser: No browser on this Host. Ask the agent to install one.

failures.hostFilesUnreachable: The Host’s files can’t be reached.

region.noH264: This browser can’t decode H.264 video.

address.noBack: No page to go back to
address.noForward: No page to go forward to

tab.createInBrowser: New Tab in the Conversation’s Browser
